hook: RTX Spark: up to 128 GB memory, 1 PFLOP AI — plus 4

items.claim: GitHub says early testing shows Gemini 4 Argon solving more coding tasks than earlier Gemini models on every coding benchmark
Apple HomeView combines smart‑home dashboard, audio, and video on a 7‑inch display
Gemini 4 Argon is built to be an active research partner, DeepMind says
NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops have up to 128 GB unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute
DeepSeek says V4.1 Flash-1017 beats its predecessor on every listed benchmark

caption: NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops bring up to 128 GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. Plus Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot, Apple HomeView, DeepMind's research partner and DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash-1017. Which is worth trying first?
